applicable_law_sections.text_summary: Defines 'defect' as any fault, imperfection or shortcoming in the quality, quantity, potency, purity or standard required by law, contract, or the seller's own claim about the goods.
A complaint must be filed with the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission within two years of the defect arising; delay can be condoned for valid reasons.

Defines 'deficiency' as any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature or manner of performance of a service required by law or contract, including negligence and deliberate withholding of relevant information.
Complaint must be filed with the District Commission within two years of the deficiency arising.

Defines 'misleading advertisement' as one that falsely describes the product/service, gives a false guarantee, conveys a representation that would amount to an unfair trade practice, or deliberately conceals material information.

Empowers the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) to order discontinuation of misleading ads and impose penalties; publishing a false/misleading advertisement can attract a penalty up to Rs 10 lakh under Section 21(4).
Mandates fixed timelines for payment of wages by the employer.
The claims authority can direct payment of the delayed wages plus compensation, ranging from roughly Rs 1,500 up to 10 times the withheld amount, capped per the section.

Only specific deductions are authorized: income tax, PF/ESI employee share, absence from duty, salary advances, court-ordered deductions, and fines up to 3% of wages. Any other deduction (e.g. for uniforms, tools, performance penalties) is unauthorized.

A workman with at least one year of continuous service cannot be retrenched unless given one month's written notice (or pay in lieu), paid compensation equal to 15 days' average pay per completed year of service, and the appropriate government is notified.

applicable_law_sections.act: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: Mandates employer contribution to the Provident Fund at the prescribed rate (typically 10-12% of basic wages plus dearness allowance) for every employee.

applicable_law_sections.act: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: Employer default in depositing PF contributions is punishable with imprisonment (up to 3 years) and fines; deducting the employee's share and failing to deposit it carries a minimum 1-year term and Rs 10,000 fine.

applicable_law_sections.act: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (if adopted by the relevant state) / applicable State Rent Control Act
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: Security deposit is capped (typically 2 months' rent for residential premises) and must be refunded at handover of vacant possession after only documented, valid deductions (damage beyond normal wear and tear, unpaid dues) — not ordinary wear and tear.

applicable_law_sections.act: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (if adopted) / applicable State Rent Control Act
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: Valid grounds for eviction are limited (e.g. non-payment of rent for over two consecutive months, unauthorized occupation, misuse after written notice) — eviction outside these grounds, or without due process, is not lawful.

applicable_law_sections.act: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (if adopted) / tenancy agreement terms
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: In the absence of a revision clause in the tenancy agreement, the landlord must give at least three months' prior written notice before revising rent; if the tenant does not respond with a termination notice, the increase is deemed accepted.

applicable_law_sections.act: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (if adopted) / applicable State Rent Control Act
applicable_law_sections.section_number: Landlord's duty to issue rent receipt
applicable_law_sections.text_summary: On receipt of rent, the landlord is obligated to provide the tenant a duly signed receipt. If the landlord refuses to accept rent or give a receipt, the tenant may send the rent by postal money order as documented proof of payment.

section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या बताया गया कारण भुगतान वेतन अधिनियम के तहत कानूनी रूप से अधिकृत कटौतियों (कर, PF/ESI, अनुपस्थिति, अग्रिम, न्यायालय आदेश, या वेतन का 3% तक जुर्माना) में से किसी से मेल खाता है?

section_facts.question_text_en: Had you completed at least one year of continuous service with this employer before termination?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या समाप्ति से पहले आपने इस नियोक्ता के साथ कम से कम एक वर्ष की निरंतर सेवा पूरी की थी?

section_facts.question_text_en: Did you receive written notice (or pay in lieu of notice) before the termination?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या समाप्ति से पहले आपको लिखित सूचना (या सूचना के बदले वेतन) मिली थी?

section_facts.question_text_en: Were you paid retrenchment compensation (15 days' average pay per completed year of service)?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपको छंटनी मुआवजा (प्रत्येक पूर्ण वर्ष की सेवा के लिए 15 दिनों का औसत वेतन) दिया गया?

section_facts.question_text_en: Was your termination the result of disciplinary action (e.g. misconduct)?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपकी समाप्ति अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई (जैसे कदाचार) के परिणामस्वरूप हुई थी?

section_facts.question_text_en: Does your employer's establishment have 100 or more workers?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपके नियोक्ता के प्रतिष्ठान में 100 या अधिक कर्मचारी हैं?

section_facts.question_text_en: Does your salary slip show a Provident Fund (PF) deduction each month?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपकी वेतन पर्ची में हर महीने भविष्य निधि (PF) कटौती दिखाई जाती है?

section_facts.question_text_en: Has it been confirmed (e.g. via EPFO passbook) that your employer did not deposit the deducted PF amount?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या यह पुष्टि हुई है (जैसे EPFO पासबुक के माध्यम से) कि आपके नियोक्ता ने कटौती की गई PF राशि जमा नहीं की?

section_facts.question_text_en: For how many months has this non-deposit occurred?
section_facts.question_text_hi: यह जमा न होने की समस्या कितने महीनों से हो रही है?

section_facts.question_text_en: What was the security deposit amount?
section_facts.question_text_hi: सुरक्षा जमा राशि कितनी थी?

section_facts.question_text_en: What is/was the monthly rent?
section_facts.question_text_hi: मासिक किराया कितना है/था?

section_facts.question_text_en: Did the landlord document any specific damage to justify withholding the deposit?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या मकान मालिक ने जमा राशि रोकने के लिए किसी विशिष्ट क्षति का दस्तावेजीकरण किया?

section_facts.question_text_en: How many days has it been since you vacated the property?
section_facts.question_text_hi: संपत्ति खाली किए हुए कितने दिन हो गए हैं?

section_facts.question_text_en: Has your state formally adopted the Model Tenancy Act, 2021?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपके राज्य ने आदर्श किरायेदारी अधिनियम, 2021 को औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया है?

section_facts.question_text_en: Did you receive written notice (or pay in lieu of notice) before the termination?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या समाप्ति से पहले आपको लिखित सूचना (या सूचना के बदले वेतन) मिली थी?

section_facts.question_text_en: How many days of notice (if any) did you actually receive?
section_facts.question_text_hi: आपको वास्तव में कितने दिनों की सूचना (यदि कोई हो) मिली?

section_facts.question_text_en: Are your rent payments up to date (no unpaid dues)?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपका किराया भुगतान वर्तमान में अद्यतन है (कोई बकाया नहीं)?

section_facts.question_text_en: Do you have a written tenancy agreement?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपके पास लिखित किरायेदारी समझौता है?

section_facts.question_text_en: By what percentage was your rent increased?
section_facts.question_text_hi: आपका किराया कितने प्रतिशत बढ़ाया गया?

section_facts.question_text_en: How many days of advance notice did your landlord give before increasing the rent?
section_facts.question_text_hi: किराया बढ़ाने से पहले मकान मालिक ने कितने दिन पहले सूचना दी?

section_facts.question_text_en: Does your written tenancy agreement specify its own rent revision terms?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपके लिखित किरायेदारी समझौते में किराया संशोधन की अपनी शर्तें निर्दिष्ट हैं?

section_facts.question_text_en: Did the landlord make any structural improvement to the property that could justify the increase?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या मकान मालिक ने संपत्ति में कोई संरचनात्मक सुधार किया जो वृद्धि को उचित ठहरा सके?

section_facts.question_text_en: How do you pay your rent (cash, bank transfer, UPI, cheque)?
section_facts.question_text_hi: आप अपना किराया कैसे भुगतान करते हैं (नकद, बैंक ट्रांसफर, UPI, चेक)?

section_facts.question_text_en: Have you requested a rent receipt in writing (SMS, email, WhatsApp)?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या आपने लिखित रूप में (SMS, ईमेल, व्हाट्सएप) किराया रसीद का अनुरोध किया है?

section_facts.question_text_en: Did the landlord explicitly refuse to give you a rent receipt?
section_facts.question_text_hi: क्या मकान मालिक ने किराया रसीद देने से स्पष्ट रूप से इनकार किया?
